root_text: People in India are so innocent that they think this is the first case of HMPV, but they don't realize it's just the first detected case. Meanwhile, in reality, thousands, maybe even millions, of cases might be traveling unnoticed every day

nodes.author: DstDhananjay
nodes.text:
People in India are so innocent that they think this is the first case of HMPV, but they don't realize it's just the first detected case. Meanwhile, in reality, thousands, maybe even millions, of cases might be traveling unnoticed every day. 
#HMPV

nodes.author: DstDhananjay
nodes.text: Now, we just have to pray that it doesn't become as severe as COVID, or else everything will repeat the same way.
